summary.tldr: Requires certain inmates to be classified and housed as maximum security, and makes them ineligible for unescorted temporary absence.
what_it_does: Requires the Correctional Service to assign a maximum security classification to inmates found to be dangerous offenders or convicted of more than one first degree murder.
Requires inmates with a maximum security classification to be confined in a penitentiary or area of a penitentiary that is classified as maximum security.
Makes transfers subject to the new rule that certain inmates must be classified as maximum security.
Makes maximum security offenders ineligible for an unescorted temporary absence.
who_it_affects: People convicted twice of first degree murder
summary.background: The bill amends the Corrections and Conditional Release Act.
